## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 60 captures during October 2018. Activity for the month was completed at the site as part of routine primary care operations. The recorded total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There was 1 ungradable capture, resulting in an ungradable rate of 1.7 per cent. The ungradable result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the month.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. No further operational issue was identified in the available site information.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results from the October 2018 activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central interval for completed grading remained limited during the reporting period.

Overall, the site recorded 60 captures, with 1 ungradable result and 6 referable results. The findings provide a concise summary of activity, image quality and grading performance at Oakridge Primary Care for October 2018.
